summary: skills-lifecycle-manager and skills-governance-audit are the two governance entry points. Each names the other and states which first question it owns. They do not share a distinctive responsibility phrase, so the conflict report emits no finding for the pair. That stated handoff is the overlap. Which skill runs follows skills-governance/docs/routing-precedence.md (ACM-136).
boundary: Use skills-lifecycle-manager when the first question is whether to reuse, install, fork, or build. Use skills-governance-audit when the first question is what is going on in the skill set.

skills-governance/skills/skills-governan: `skills-lifecycle-manager` for reuse/install/fork/build decisions across source classes
skills-governance/skills/skills-lifecycl: use `skills-lifecycle-manager` when the first question is "should we reuse, install, fork, or build"
use `skills-governance-audit` when the first question is "what is going on in this skill set"
